payload.title: Company layer has no read model: the auth tenant identity and module list are tenant-admin only, and Company workforce and registry views reuse module pages over module-private types (Employee contact PII, farm Site), so a Company viewer without module grants cannot be served without module-private fields
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/resolvers/tenant.resolver.ts:158-161 (myTenant, the company identity, is TenantAdminOrHigher only)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/org.ts:58-61 (the Company workforce view is the HR module pages themselves)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/entities/employee.entity.ts:190-200 (Employee type exposes email, contactInfo and address)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/hr.resolver.ts:83-93 (full contact PII is returned to any global TENANT_ADMIN or MODULE_MANAGER)
payload.rule_violated: D1 and D2: Company is a read-only umbrella over common kinds, and a Company role never sees module-private data.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-33, release R10.
